title: Chapter 480 Wang Shuo Vs Anna
content:
Chapter 480 Wang Shuo Vs Anna

The number of the strongest kings in the Wana Empire has reached 32.

There was no need for Wang Shuo to do anything, Ayub sent people to occupy all the small forces and cities far away.

In the northeast, the army of the Wana Empire was divided into ten routes.

Heading towards the capital of the Truni Empire.

All the generals worked very hard.

They also knew that this battle was the prelude to the unification of the Shenwu Empire.

After the war, there would definitely be rewards for merit.

As long as you perform well, it would not be a problem to be made a marquis or a prime minister.

And you will also get a large piece of fiefdom.

The ten armies marched in unison, attacking cities and strongholds all the way.

In less than a month, they arrived at the capital of the Truni Empire.

Wang Shuo also followed the army and came to the camp ten miles outside the city.

In fact, for a war like this, Wang Shuo didn't need to come in person.

But Wang Shuo just wanted to see what happened to Queen Anna.

One of the important reasons why Ayub advanced so quickly was that Queen Anna concentrated most of the empire's troops in the capital.

Under the city wall, the army of the Truni Empire was ready for battle.

Wang Shuo could see the black army from a distance.

"This is what it looks like!" Wang Shuo still admired Queen Anna from the bottom of his heart.

A queen who grew up after her family was wiped out and suffered countless hardships.

She is indeed capable.

She did not give up resistance, which is better than many people.

Moreover, she still had to fight to the death with Wang Shuo outside the city, which made Wang Shuo look up to her even more.

But Wang Shuo was very confident that all this was in vain.

At this time, a passage was separated from the enemy's formation.

Queen Anna appeared at the front.

"Wang Shuo, come out!"

Queen Anna used her internal force, and her voice was very loud, shaking the four fields.

Wang Shuo heard her voice and walked out of the formation.

"Anna, do you have any last words?"

Wang Shuo rode on Da Huang, looking relaxed.

"Wang Shuo, since ancient times, the winners are the kings and the losers are the bandits. As a king, I should die with dignity. Do you dare to fight me fairly?"

Wang Shuo sneered.

"Why not?"

Wang Shuo was very confident in his own strength.

Could it be that the last battle in the Frost Empire gave her confidence and made her have the illusion that she could defeat herself?

Wang Shuo couldn't help shaking his head.

"Your Majesty, no, now our strength can completely crush her, there is no need to risk our lives."

At this time, there were still subordinates who spoke out to stop him.

But the core ministers of the empire did not speak, because they all knew how powerful Wang Shuo was.

"It doesn't matter, just give her a decent death!"

Wang Shuo clamped his legs, and Da Huang rushed out like a sharp arrow.

A Shura Demon-Breaking Spear, shining brightly under the sunlight.

Queen Anna also immediately stepped into the air and flew towards Wang Shuo.

The two of them started a fierce battle in front of the two armies.

This time, Wang Shuo did not hold back at all and fired at full power.

Queen Anna was shocked and could not believe it.

At this time, she finally realized that Wang Shuo had been hiding his abilities before.

However, it didn't matter.

She was prepared to fight for the last chance today.

If Wang Shuo could be defeated, the Truni Empire might still be able to escape this disaster.

If not, the empire would be destroyed soon, and she did not want to live alone.

After the two exchanged a few moves, Wang Shuo directly used "Shura Slash."

Although the momentum was not enough, it was enough to injure Anna.

Then she could use "Dawei Tianlong".
